title: Schema.org WebPage
description: A web page. Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage.

name.description: The name of the web page.

description.description: A description of the web page.

lastReviewed.description: Date on which the content on this web page was last reviewed for accuracy.

mainContentOfPage.description: Indicates if this web page element is the main subject of the page.

primaryImageOfPage.description: Indicates the main image on the page.

breadcrumb.description: A set of links that can help a user understand and navigate a website hierarchy.

mainEntity.description: Indicates the primary entity described in some page or other CreativeWork.

significantLink.description: One of the more significant URLs on the page.

speakable.description: Indicates sections that are particularly speakable.

specialty.description: One of the domain specialties to which this web page's content applies.

relatedLink.description: A link related to this web page.

reviewedBy.description: People or organizations that have reviewed the content on this web page.

author.description: The author of this web page.

publisher.description: The publisher of this web page.

dateModified.description: The date on which the page was most recently modified.

isPartOf.description: Indicates the WebSite that this page is part of.

sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity.
